setup_logger: setup a detectron2 logger with colored stdout output and file logging to a specified output directory
log_first_n: log a message only for the first n calls from the same caller or message key
log_every_n: log a message once every n calls from the same caller location
log_every_n_seconds: log a message no more than once every n seconds from the same caller location
create_small_table: create a formatted pipe-style table string from a small dictionary of key-value pairs
